note: The .sav carries NO variable labels and NO value labels (all 53 columns label to None), so this is NOT data_labels despite the source being an SPSS file; the paper never reproduces item wording either. mapping_basis=reconstructed: the codes UCLA1..UCLA8 are the .sav column names verbatim (data/gan_2015_nursing_home.py melts them with no renaming, so there is no positional step), and they were tied to the canonical ULS-8 item numbering, then checked against the data. Checks (see verify_gan_2015_ucla_loneliness.R): Cronbach's alpha of the eight columns AS STORED is 0.7111 against the paper's published .71; the .sav's own Loneliness composite equals the mean of the eight stored columns to 0.0 for all 71 respondents, matching the ULS-8 scoring rule 'Average the 8-item scores'; no item has a negative item-rest correlation (min 0.120 at UCLA3); UCLA3 and UCLA6 are each other's strongest correlate (r=0.295) and re-flipping {3,6} costs the least alpha of all 28 candidate pairs (0.6071, next {3,7} 0.5989) -- the residual method factor of the two already-reversed items. CONSEQUENCE FOR option_text, and the one deliberate deviation from the printed form: because the stored values are the SCORED values, UCLA3 and UCLA6 ship inverted anchors (resp 1=Always ... 4=Never) while the other six ship 1=Never ... 4=Always. This follows the burkert_2019_whoqol_bref precedent of shipping anchors that match the data. Anchor wording: endpoints 'never'/'always' are the study's own ('a four-point Likert scale, ranging from 1 (never) to 4 (always)'); the middle two, Rarely and Sometimes, are the canonical form's. Note the canonical UCLA form prints Often, not Always, at 4 -- the study's stated wording was preferred. instructions is the canonical ULS-8 form's own line, not the study's (the study administered a Chinese paper questionnaire and neither the paper nor the deposit reproduces its instruction text). text_source=translated_substitute: administered in Chinese to Chinese nursing-home residents; the deposit is a single .sav with zero text fields and the paper has no other supplement, so no Chinese wording is recoverable in scope and the _translated columns are correctly empty with language=Chinese. RIGHTS: no quotable restriction found. The wording was copied from Ron D. Hays' (ULS-8 co-author) own UCLA-hosted PDF, which states no fee, no non-commercial clause and no redistribution bar; the 2026-09-04 quote tests do not fire, so no wording_rights is set.

Note also that the deposited responses are already reverse-scored, so for UCLA3 and UCLA6 the shipped anchors run 1 = Always to 4 = Never, the opposite of the other six items
